purpose: First real LoRA smoke run on Kaggle, on synthetic starter data, to prove the pipeline end to end: environment, pinned base, training, save, reload, inference and persistence. Not a Klyvaron tier and not a release.

dataset.contentsDescription: SYNTHETIC DEMONSTRATION DATA generated by fabric/training/synthetic.py from fixed rules and a fixed seed: arithmetic, word reversal, letter and vowel counts, uppercase, number sorting, and held-out colour questions. Answers are computed by Python. Not collected data, not user data, not domain knowledge.

resources.note: Estimates, not measurements. Kaggle documents 12-hour GPU sessions (kaggle.com/docs/notebooks). Replace the estimates with the measured peak memory and time of the first session.

resume.instructions: Save Version > Save & Run All on Kaggle with the same notebook. To resume, add the earlier committed version's output as Input and list its checkpoints directory under checkpoint.resumeFrom in a new copy of this job file.
